depiction of hair or beard mass
justification: Both depict the human form and a face, but A is a relief frieze of a repeated procession of striding figures in strict profile carrying bowls and other offerings, with elaborately patterned coiffures, drapery folds and articulated hands, while B is a single free-standing crudely blocked-out figure with a lumpy schematic face and no attributes, relationships or scene. Beyond the universal fact of 'a human figure with a face', there is no shared motif, posture, attribute, composition or carving convention.
